title: API Keys
desc: Manage keys that authenticate to the inference proxy and agent channel. These are not login credentials.
info: API keys authenticate to specific endpoints — inference keys for the <1>{{proxy}}</1> proxy, agent keys for the agent channel. Login uses a separate cookie session — a login credential is not an API key, and vice versa.
noKeysAgent: Create an agent key to authenticate to the agent channel.
noKeysInference: Create an inference key to authenticate clients against the /v1 proxy.
createDescAgent: Create a key to authenticate to the agent channel (<1>{{channel1}}</1>, <2>{{channel2}}</2>). These keys are <3>not</3> login credentials.
createDescInference: Create a key to authenticate to the inference proxy (<1>{{proxy}}</1>). These keys are <3>not</3> login credentials.
keyCreated: Key created — copy your secret now.
keyCreatedDesc: This is the only time the full secret is shown. Store it somewhere safe.
rotated: Key rotated — copy your new secret now.
rotateWarningComplete: Rotating the key invalidates the previous secret. Deployers of this key must replace their credentials now.

revoke.desc: Existing clients will lose access immediately.

manage.fullAccessDesc: This key can call every provider and model. Turn off to restrict it below.
manage.grantAllModels: Tick a provider to grant all of its models, or pick individual models for a narrower grant.
manage.couldntLoadCatalog: The provider/model catalog isn't available right now.
manage.couldntLoadAccess: Couldn't load this key's current access.
manage.discardChangesDesc: Access changes for this key haven't been saved yet.
manage.unmatchedGrant: Also granted (no longer in the catalog):
manage.nothingSelected: Nothing selected — this key can't call any provider or model. Pick at least one, or re-enable Full access.
manage.noUsage: No usage recorded for this key in the selected window.
